prompt: Trimethyl(butyl)ammonium hydroxide (CH3CH2CH2CH2-N⁺Me3 OH⁻) is heated. Draw the MAJOR alkene product.

traps.note: Hofmann prefers LESS substituted alkene (bulky NMe3 forces anti-periplanar at the less-hindered β-H).

explanation: E2 from quaternary ammonium with -OH: steric bulk of NMe3 and leaving-group preference make the TS go through the less hindered β-H → terminal (less substituted) alkene wins. Opposite of Zaitsev for small halides.
